entities.name: Feroz
entities.description: Planeswalker who thought using summoned beings was immoral; founded the Wizards' School on Ulgrotha.

entities.name: Root Spider
entities.description: Creature Feroz and Sandruu were fighting when he met Serra.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Vampire at Castle Sengir who warned Feroz and Serra not to interfere.

entities.name: An-Havva Inn
entities.description: Inn where Feroz and Serra met the Baron.

entities.name: Wizards' School
entities.description: School founded by Feroz on Ulgrotha.

entities.name: Beast Walkers
entities.description: Taught shape changing by Feroz as Porrin.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: Planeswalker who chased Sandruu home and defeated him; defeated by Feroz.

entities.name: Feroz's Ban
entities.description: Created by Feroz to protect Ulgrotha from planeswalker incursions.

events.summary: Feroz befriended the Anaba minotaur Sandruu on Ulgrotha.
events.quote: where he befriended the Anaba minotaur Sandruu

events.summary: Feroz met Serra while fighting a Root Spider, and eventually married her.
events.quote: he met Serra , whom he eventually married

events.summary: Baron Sengir warned them not to interfere; they ignored him and helped the Ulgrothans defend themselves.
events.quote: Feroz and Serra ignored this warning and helped the Ulgrothan people defend themselves against him

events.summary: Feroz founded his Wizards' School and helped Sandruu ascend.
Feroz defeated Taysir and created Feroz's Ban to protect the plane from planeswalker incursions.
events.quote: Feroz defeated Taysir in return and created Feroz's Ban

events.summary: Feroz died in a lab accident while studying a fire elemental trapped in ice.
events.quote: Feroz died in a lab accident while studying a fire elemental trapped in ice.
